title: ECorp × ProgramBench — gron pilot results

metadata.title: ECorp × ProgramBench — gron pilot results

ecorp.configuration: Windows ECorp runner plus a local task-scoped native Codex executor adapter patch
ecorp.upstream_equivalence: This measures the documented local integration, not unmodified upstream or a general UI provider-selection feature.

benchmark.pilot_scope: One program, gron, with all official active cases; cases are not separate programs.
benchmark.selection_rationale: One small official suite selected before candidate generation/results; a feasibility pilot, not a representative sample or leaderboard submission.

model.provider: Configured copilot_proxy Responses gateway (described by the user as remote Portkey)
model.name: gpt-6-astra
model.selection: Trusted task-scoped adapter configuration explicitly binds model/effort; four sanitized native turn-context records confirm these settings.
model.planner_limitation: Persisted task/run model and effort fields remain null because stock discovery/effort validation cannot select this provider's gpt-6-astra/ultra. This is not a general UI selection feature.
model.credentials: Existing configured provider reused; credential values were not serialized into this report or mounted into the agent container.

native_telemetry.interpretation: Native Codex telemetry confirms provider name, model and effort. It does not independently attest the configured proxy's upstream route or monetary cost.
native_telemetry.excluded: No prompt, response, credential, shell command or tool output is exported.

resources.cost_note: Monetary cost is unavailable. The adapter's zero cost_microusd values are not evidence of free inference or proof that the configured monetary ceiling was enforced.

tomnomnom__gron.88a6234.tenant_scope_note: Corp is the explicit scope in the recorded ECorp objects; no separate tenant ID was supplied.

authorization.mode: Development-principal operations under the user's benchmark request
authorization.budget_approvals: Two programmatic development-owner decisions; original spend and history retained.
authorization.artifact_authorization: Owned development API actor authorization; server verifies stored artifact bytes/provenance; this client checks matching signature headers and SHA-256 without independently verifying signature cryptography.

budget_revisions.rationale: Finish the user-requested ProgramBench gron run using the already configured provider. Retain 508647 spent tokens and the same task/worktree/verifier. Allow only finishing current self-checks, necessary implementation corrections and source evidence; no publication or additional programs.
budget_revisions.decision_note: Bounded continuation of the same user-authorized benchmark task. Original spend, source, attempts and verifier remain unchanged. No independent human review or publication is asserted.

budget_revisions.rationale: Finalize the existing completed implementation for the user-requested ProgramBench run. Preserve all 1040903 metered tokens, original attempts, worktree and verifier. Only a minimal provider completion is needed so ECorp can verify and export; no further implementation, exploration, programs or publication.
budget_revisions.decision_note: Bounded finalization of the same user-authorized benchmark. Existing spend, source, attempts and persisted verifier remain unchanged. No independent human review is asserted.

run_and_budget_lineage.history: Initial namespace failure, one repair/resume, two budget suspensions and owner-authorized resumes, final native completion of the same source/session. No earlier spend or failure was removed.

environment_evidence.detail: Mission/task/final run completed; 4 native verifier checks passed; exact source export downloaded and frozen.
Final Edge inspection shows the exact completed run and enabled source download with no page/console errors. Initial mission launch also used the browser.
Four turn contexts for the same provider session identify copilot_proxy, gpt-6-astra and ultra. The upstream proxy route and pricing were not independently verified.
Internal Docker network; provider credentials, original source and held-out tests not mounted. Preflight found no proxy key and returned network-unreachable on outbound connection.
Docker seccomp=unconfined was required for native bubblewrap namespaces; other recorded mount/network boundaries remained. This is an experimental local configuration.
Migrations, formatting, Clippy and workspace tests passed. Workspace tests: 554 passed, 323 ignored; initial missing npm prerequisite and corrected rerun retained.
Both official web commands passed on an exact copied source runtime; web/browser receipts retained.

compatibility.evidence: A real ECorp provider session generated a source deliverable, followed by separate official ProgramBench evaluation of the frozen archive.
compatibility.recommendation: Retain this one-program result as a feasibility baseline; broaden program coverage for comparative claims.

compatibility.evidence: Native environment registration and turn selection bind the isolated task directory and configured gpt-6-astra/ultra. Stock planner fields remain null.
compatibility.recommendation: A general provider-selection UI and broader runner support remain separate product work.

compatibility.evidence: Four runs share one provider session/worktree. Token authority increased 500,000 → 1,000,000 → 1,250,000; all 1,102,188 metered tokens remain recorded.
compatibility.recommendation: Compare systems under equal declared token budgets; add monetary metering before cost-efficiency claims.

compatibility.evidence: The cleanroom used internal networking and no credential/source/test mounts, with Docker seccomp=unconfined to enable native bubblewrap.
compatibility.recommendation: Do not present this as default upstream isolation or production security certification.

compatibility.evidence: ECorp's four checks prove recorded runtime/source/artifact conditions. Functional equivalence is measured by the subsequent official test suite.
compatibility.recommendation: Keep the candidate frozen; report test failures without feeding held-out results into the same scored attempt.

compatibility.evidence: ANSI color output and flag precedence: 4; Ungron statement handling, separators, errors and invocation: 8; URL fetching, proxy behavior and network error fidelity: 12
compatibility.recommendation: Treat these as held-out observations on this frozen candidate; all individual failures are retained below.

limitations: This is one gron program out of 200, evaluated with a local ECorp adapter patch; it is not a full benchmark score, official leaderboard submission, matched baseline comparison, or statistically representative result.

The inferred provider route is the user's configured copilot_proxy Responses gateway, described by the user as remote Portkey. Native telemetry confirms configured provider/model/effort, not the ultimate upstream route or pricing.
Monetary cost is unavailable; recorded zero cost values do not show that inference was free or that the persisted $1 monetary budget was enforceable.
Two budget increases were approved programmatically through a development principal. They are not independent human verification or production authentication evidence.

Docker seccomp=unconfined is a deliberate deviation required to run native bubblewrap in this container; the recorded network and mount controls do not amount to a comprehensive security certification.
Stock model discovery/effort validation cannot select this configured model/ultra through the mission UI. Persisted model/effort remain null; the trusted adapter binds them for this task.
Reference-binary diagnostics and repository/helper tests are excluded from every ECorp candidate score and execution count.

methodology: Reads existing official evaluator output; this generator launches no benchmark work.
The official active-branch and ignored-test filters apply before scoring.
Executed = eligible passed or failure cases matched to recorded run_tests and results_read JUnit evidence.
Errors can occur in setup; errors, skipped, system_error and not_run are reported separately from executed cases.
A complete program score uses the official retained-test denominator, including skipped, error and not_run outcomes.
The pilot mean is available only when every selected real program has complete, consistent candidate and evaluator evidence.
Missing candidate/output is not scored as a benchmark failure. Unknown programs and fixtures receive no score.
No full-benchmark leaderboard score is claimed. Coverage and pilot mean are distinct.
Local log consistency does not independently authenticate inference, ECorp lineage, source independence, or network isolation.
